description: Labelled questions over retrieval_corpus.json. `required`: provisions that must be in the top 10. `related`: provisions that must arrive through expansion, or in the results. Kinds: clause (named by number), term (a defined term), keyword (the wording's own words), paraphrase (other words for the same thing), facts (de-identified claim facts, as the Policy Agent will ask).
